nonclaims: The unconditional reverse inclusion from arbitrary distributional H(div) graph data into the Schwartz graph closure is not yet proved.

The exact Bessel/Riesz reconstruction identity—and therefore the converse equivalence from the new H1 graph relation to Bessel-potential InH1—is not yet proved.
The v3.30 Lean endpoints remain unverified; the Python claim-policy tests passed on the observed prior commit only.
